title: potentilla tabernaemontani subvar. oblongifolia
intro: Potentilla tabernaemontani subvar. oblongifolia, commonly known as the Himalayan Cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its hairy, gray-green stems and leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of P. tabernaemontani subvar. oblongifolia include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and display anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
